{
  "name": "auto-model",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "description": "Picks the model for each turn from how hard your prompt looks: haiku, sonnet, opus or fable, with high thinking effort on every tier by default.",
  "author": {
    "name": "chenp"
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "judge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "How difficulty is judged",
      "description": "heuristic: local rules, instant and free. model: a quick call to the judge model reads the prompt first (adds about a second and a small cost), falling back to the rules if it fails.",
      "default": "heuristic",
      "options": [
        "heuristic",
        "model"
      ]
    },
    "judgeModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Judge model",
      "description": "Model alias or full id that grades prompts when the judge is model. A fast model is enough.",
      "default": "haiku"
    },
    "modelEasy": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Easy prompts: model",
      "description": "Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full model id, for easy prompts.",
      "default": "haiku"
    },
    "effortEasy": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Easy prompts: thinking effort",
      "description": "Thinking effort for easy prompts.",
      "default": "high",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ]
    },
    "modelMedium": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Medium prompts: model",
      "description": "Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full model id, for medium prompts.",
      "default": "sonnet"
    },
    "effortMedium": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Medium prompts: thinking effort",
      "description": "Thinking effort for medium prompts.",
      "default": "high",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ]
    },
    "modelHard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hard prompts: model",
      "description": "Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full model id, for hard prompts.",
      "default": "opus"
    },
    "effortHard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hard prompts: thinking effort",
      "description": "Thinking effort for hard prompts.",
      "default": "high",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ]
    },
    "modelExpert": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expert prompts: model",
      "description": "Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full model id, for the very hardest prompts.",
      "default": "fable"
    },
    "effortExpert": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expert prompts: thinking effort",
      "description": "Thinking effort for the very hardest prompts.",
      "default": "high",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ]
    }
  },
  "license": "MIT"
}
